posts.text: After two years building in stealth, we're going public with our launch next week. We help mid-market finance teams close the books 3x faster. If you've ever stared at a spreadsheet at 11pm on the last day of the month, you know the problem. More soon.

Hiring two more engineers and our first Head of Sales. Series A closed last month, team is doubling, the only thing holding us back from a real GTM motion is the GTM hire. If you know someone strong, please introduce us.

Lessons from year two: most of our wins came from boring fundamentals — answering support tickets ourselves, calling every customer who churned, writing the docs by hand. There is no growth hack for caring.
